title: Joyryde Full Set EDC Orlando 2018 Kinetic Field
description:
Here is our Joyryde full set at EDC Orlando 2018. Had to remove 2 songs which were:
Fade - Kanye West
Im Gone - Joyryde

We love going to the EDM festivals and recording sets for others to enjoy. We do not make any money off these videos on YouTube as all monetization goes to the music labels. In order to continue to provide these sets please consider making a small donation in support of what we do.  We eventually want to expand to other festivals as well. If you cannot donate, we still thank you for even coming to our page and watching the videos we put up. Make sure you hit SUBSCRIBE as that is the best way to show us support!!!

Consider supporting us with a donation through paypal at:

 https://www.paypal.me/floridafanatics

Festivals that we will continue to cover are Ultra Miami, EDC Las Vegas, and EDC Orlando. In the future we have our eyes set on Imagine, Sunset Music Festival, Lost Lands, Spring Awakening, Electric Zoo, and more. 

Remember to comment below as it helps promote our videos and also SUBSCRIBE!!!  

You can find us on both twitter and Instagram, although we aren’t as active there but a great way to direct message us:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/FL_FANatics
